title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection, Traditional Bath Accessory Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your bath with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass, designed to complement traditional bathroom hardware. This Carolina Collection piece makes it easy to build a coordinated set with matching Carolina classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures.

Highlights:
- Solid brass towel bar with refined, traditional styling
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean wall-mounted look
- Wall mount design is an ideal use of space
- Mounting plates and all installation hardware included
- Available in multiple designer finish options

Specs:
- Collection: Carolina Collection
- Shape: straight bar
- Length: 30 in; Center-to-center: 30 in
- Bar diameter: 0.75 in
- Overall dimensions: 30 in L x 3.5 in H x 2 in W; Projection: 2 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Screw size: #8 X 1 1/4"
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
